overview.label: Overview
overview.heading: What is Agni Yoga?
body: Agni Yoga, the yoga of Living Ethics, is a spiritual path—not of physical disciplines, meditation, or asceticism, as in the past—but of practice in daily life. It is a yoga of fiery energy, of consciousness, of responsible, directed thought.

It is a Teaching that offers practical guidance for the conscious development of the human spirit—not as a retreat from the world but through the transformation of a person’s inner and outer being through their increasing beauty, service, and striving. Particular attention is paid to the development of concentrated thinking and complete concentration of thought upon a chosen object. Such concentration and meditation constitute the most important part of spiritual upbringing.

Agni Yoga teaches that the evolution of the planetary consciousness is a pressing necessity and that, through individual striving, it is an attainable aspiration for humankind. It affirms the existence of the Hierarchy of Light and the center of the Heart as the link with the Hierarchy and with the far-off worlds.
Helena Roerich, the Mother of Agni Yoga, gave humanity the Teaching of Agni Yoga, which can be understood as the Teaching of Life.

body: Helena Roerich (1879–1955) was the author and recorder of the Agni Yoga series, transmitted in collaboration with the Masters of the Agni Yoga Hierarchy. Her extensive Letters provide additional guidance on the path of Living Ethics.

Nicholas Roerich (1874–1947) was a Russian artist, explorer, and peace activist whose Himalayan paintings have become iconic symbols of the spiritual path described in the Teachings. He founded the Agni Yoga Society, Inc. in New York in 1920.

Together they worked to make the Teachings available to the West, presenting a synthesis of ancient Eastern wisdom and modern Western thought. Nicholas was also the originator of the Roerich Pact, an international treaty for the protection of cultural property.
Their lives and the Teaching they transmitted remain inseparable — the paintings, the letters, and the books form a unified body of spiritual instruction for those on the path of conscious evolution.

community.label: This Community
community.heading: The Agni Yoga World Community
community.body: The AYWC exists to connect independent study groups, organizations, and individual seekers across the globe — sharing news, events, translations, and insights to support each other on this path. We hold no hierarchy, charge no fees, and require no membership.
